info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Brand Update API
info.description: The Brand Update API enables businesses to modify existing brand information, ensuring that marketing materials and customer communications reflect accurate and current brand details. This endpoint allows for the partial update of brand attributes, such as name, logo, or taglines, and is crucial for maintaining brand consistency across various channels. Typical consumers include marketing teams and brand managers who need to make updates based on strategic decisions or market changes. Utilize this API to enhance brand representation and engagement effectively.
